import subprocess,re
s=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-SW','/workspace/a.out'],text=True)
secs=[]; total_words=0

 m=re.match(r'\s*\[\s*\d+\]\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)',line)
 if not m: continue
 name,typ,addr,off,size=m.groups()
 if typ=='NOBITS': continue
 # flags not captured; approximate from known alloc sections by addr/type? use later readelf -S -> Flg
 secs.append((name,typ,int(addr,16),int(off,16),int(size,16)))
# parse flags properly
s2=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-SW','/workspace/a.out'],text=True)
for line in s2.splitlines():
 m=re.match(r'\s*\[\s*(\d+)\]\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+([0-9a-f]+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)',line)
 if not m: continue
 idx,name,typ,addr,off,size,es,flg=m.groups()
 if 'A' in flg and typ!='NOBITS':
  words=(int(size,16)+3)//4
  if int(size,16)>0:
   print(name,hex(int(addr,16)),int(size,16),words,flg)
